facts.text: Saint Marys is the ferry departure point for the passenger ferry to Cumberland Island.
Saint Marys hosts annual Mardi Gras celebrations, an Independence Day Festival, a Seafood Festival, and a Music in the Park Series.
Saint Marys sits on the St. Marys River, just north of the Florida border, with Cumberland Island National Seashore to the northeast.
The original Spanish settlement founded in 1566 makes Saint Marys the second‑oldest continuously inhabited European‑established settlement in the contiguous United States.
Saint Marys is bordered by the Kings Bay Naval Submarine Base, home port for several Ohio‑class submarines.
Saint Marys’ history walk and waterfront park offer biking trails and boat ramps, showcasing its maritime heritage.
